l.i: HExilogia utilitatem in limine hujus tractatus uno
verbo indicavi. Hic sub finem clarius ob oculos
veluti ponam. Ponam autem hoc modo.
Sicut Archelogia est prima alphabeti philosophici

main_text.l: pars, exponens hæc vocabula, principium, conclu-
sio, eorumq; synonyma, epitheta, & antitheta: ita he-

l.i: xilogia est secunda alphabeti philosophici pars, expo-

main_text.l: nens hæc vocabula, intelligentia, scientia, sapien-
tia, synteresis, prudentia, & similia; quæ in philo-

l.i: sophiæ partibus occurrunt. Vocabula ista omnino præ-
cognoscenda sunt, ut scire queat philosophiæ studiosus,

main_text.l: bula communia in plerisque, vel omnibus di-
hæc: sapientia, scientia, prudentia, ars. Omnis e-

l.i: nim disciplina est vel sapientia, vel scientia, vel pru-
dentia, vel ars. Philosophia autem & Theologia sunt

main_text.l: habitus mixti ex illis simplicibus. Vocabula com-
munia, quæ in plerisq; disciplinis & facultatibus oc-
organico-mechanicus: illius mentio sæpe fit in di-

l.i: sciplinis contemplativis: ijtius[?] in activis; hujus in factivis:

main_text.l: itē[?], fides divina, & visio Dei: quæ duo vocabula
persæpe in SS. Theologia usurpantur. Vocabula de-
niq; communia, quæ in omnib. & singulis disci-
plinis occurrūt, sunt: opinio, fides humana, du-
bitatio, suspicio, error. Iccirco hexilogia, ut & ar-

l.i: chelog. est ad instar Lexici philosophici cujus utilitate
infignem si necdum vides, nihil vides, vel certe invides.

page.notes: <note side="right">Hexilogiæ utilitas.</note> is printed beside the first line of the first paragraph; it is not part of the running text. Uncertain readings: "ijtius" (possibly "ejus"), "itē" (tilde over e), "plerisq;" (abbreviation mark uncertain). The drop cap H of the first paragraph is joined to the word as "HExilogia" per the printed form. Fully italic first paragraph and italic runs in the second paragraph are marked as they appear on the scan.
